Manufacturer documentation specifies a 235 x 275 mm top storage area and identifies BIOCUT as a manual mechanical microtome.

Machined orientation-head spindle and clamp jaws, fasteners and adjustment knobs follow the articulated specimen carriage.
Blade-holder base, pressure plate and clamp levers; U-shaped red safety guard follows its existing actuator.
Light handwheel with dark perimeter and separate coarse-feed wheel; retained specimen/blade target sites and control interfaces.
